name: Брадгар Дур-Молок
notes: Bradgar the Anvil, a dwarf of the Kragmir fighting club, founder and captain of the Fist of Kragmir, its champion arena team: 76 wins over the last ten years. Every teammate from the early rosters is dead or gone (the big arena of Kragmir allows killing); only Bradgar has stood through all of it. He fights in mithras full plate behind a tower shield, anchors the front, and steadies his allies with a battle cadence. He is slow, and very hard to move or to drop. In ten years on the big arena he has faced the Судья, the caged dragon of the final stage, more often than any dwarf alive, and never won: his teams died there and he always walked back up. He reads big beasts and old arena machinery like a foreman reads a shift board, and he no longer flinches at anything.

actions.name: Commander's Cadence
actions.text: An aura out to 30 feet. Allies within it, Bradgar included, gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and to saves against fear. It applies and clears on its own as tokens move.

actions.name: Voice of the Pit
actions.text: Bradgar calls the fight for one ally within 60 feet who can hear him. Until the start of his next turn, that ally gains @UUID[Compendium.the-shards-forge.shards-abilities.Item.shardsbradgvoice]{Effect: Voice of the Pit}: a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and saving throws, and a +2 circumstance bonus (instead) to checks to repair, load, or operate a siege engine.

actions.name: Rooted
actions.text: Bradgar gains a +2 circumstance bonus to defenses against forced movement and to his Athletics DC against Shove, Trip, and Reposition.

actions.name: Pit Veteran
actions.text: Ten years of walking down to the Судья and walking back up alone. When Bradgar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition, reduce its value by 1.
